selection: Minimum visible e<->C and e<->I validation prediction MSE, independently within each family, ties by declared grid order. Fixed 400-update endpoint. No CI/ICI inputs, hidden labels, collision scores or compound validation in fitting or selection.
coordinate_system: One common FIT-only mean and isotropic scale for all known e/C/I states. Convert affine maps back into original hidden coordinates before frozen-readout evaluation.
norm_constraint: Projected Adam: clip all singular values of each 256x256 linear map to the candidate cap every ten updates and after the final update; affine bias unconstrained.
roundtrip_constraint: Generator prediction loss plus lambda times mean squared error of M_g(M_g(x))-x on both endpoints of known FIT edges, for g=C,I. Affine bias participates in both applications.
scope: Small exploratory ablation on the first three previously specified new source seeds. Native frozen baseline has zero additional optimization; unconstrained_refit has the same initialization, batches and 400-update budget as the three constrained families. Report all five. This tests use of supplied algebraic constraints, not spontaneous algebra discovery. Collision selection defines a conditional evaluation population.
